facts.big: She said the film was great
facts.label: Said / told + passado
facts.sub: Said + verbo recuado: She said it was great. Told + pessoa: She told me she was busy. Will vira would: They said they would go.

facts.label: Disse que + passado
facts.sub: Use said para repetir as palavras de alguém. O verbo costuma recuar: I am busy vira She said she was busy. That pode ser omitido: She said (that) it was good.

facts.label: Disse a alguém
facts.sub: Told precisa de alguém: She told me, He told us, I told my friends. Não diga said me. Depois vem a frase: She told me that she was busy.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: After said, the verb often goes one step back in time.
We say “She said me that it was great.”
items.why: We say She told me that it was great.

items.s: Told needs a person after it: told me, told us.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: After said, the verb often goes one step back in time. → Verdadeiro (Yes: is becomes was.)
We say “She said me that it was great.” → Falso (We say She told me that it was great.)
Told needs a person after it: told me, told us. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is a rainy Saturday in Seattle. Lia meets her friend Dora near a cinema. Lia saw a new film last night. Many people have already given their opinion. Dora wants to know what everybody said. Lia has a lot to tell her.
“Lia, did you go to the cinema last night? How was the film?” says Dora. “It was great! My sister said the plot was very clever.” says Lia. “Did she go with you? She told me she was busy.” says Dora.
